context.edition_title: Book of Common Prayer — retained HTML fixture
Book of Common Prayer — retained HTML fixture

limits: Three complete selected source units; not whole-office or whole-collection coverage.
Two heading-delimited prayers and one complete twelve-line suffrage paragraph preserve actual source boundaries.
Drop-capital image alt text restores its printed initial; strong and italic emphasis remain TEI hi and are reported when projected to plain text.
Speaker labels remain literal. Answer lines refer to their immediately preceding printed petition.
The unheaded suffrage unit receives no invented title. Office comes from its actual source page title.
No subjective audience, theme, human acceptance, rights, or publication assertion.
